title: Gateway to Julian #1
author: Martha Wild
problems: Row 3 "mad robins, robins in front moving to left in front of neighbor" can't start from where the dancers are: A mad robin needs two dancers on each side line, one above the other.
Row 1 "slice left and straight back" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancer 0 (couple 1) must stand on a side line.
choices: Slice: half the counts on the diagonal, half straight back.
A meltdown swing starts with 4 beats of right-shoulder round, then swings.
